name: The Artificer
source:
Takeru has been plagued by a shadow of a long-lost memory as far as he remembers.
His consciousness has decided to lock it away, yet it manifests stronger than ever.
Out of sudden, his normal life is brutally interrupted, and he is pulled into a web of occurrences that cannot be comprehended by reason alone.
But is it really only by chance?
In a spiral of events and new encounters, he has to face his mind head-on and unravel the reason of guilt stalking him.
All while fighting for his life against omnipresent enemy.

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/theartficer]Ren'ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
主角从记事起，便一直被一段早已遗失的记忆阴影纠缠。
意识选择将它封锁，它却以前所未有的强度不断浮现。
平凡生活突然遭到残酷打断，他被拖入一连串无法单凭理性理解的事件。
但这一切真的只是偶然吗？
在事件与新邂逅交织的漩涡中，他必须直面内心，解开如影随形的罪恶感从何而来。
与此同时，他还要与无处不在的敌人战斗，设法活下去。

[译自 [url=https://renai.us/game/theartficer]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
